name: Jen'shan
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Jen'shan prepares young hunters for the wild. The Darkspear jungle troll teaches orc and troll marksmen to track, fight at range, and survive.

sections.title: Mentor of the Red Sands
sections.body: Jen'shan trains new hunters in the Valley of Trials. Young orcs and Darkspear trolls find her by following inscribed tablets and parchments. She teaches archery, marksmanship, and wilderness survival, readying them for the scorpids and boars on the canyon floor.

faq.answer: Jen'shan is a Darkspear jungle troll who trains hunters in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. She teaches young Horde hunters to track, understand the wilderness, and fight at range.
Young hunters go to Jen'shan for their first training. Orcs bring her an Etched Tablet, while trolls seek her with an Etched Parchment.

faq.q: Why is a troll training hunters in an orc proving ground?
aliases: why is a troll in valley of trials
faq.answer: The Valley of Trials trains orc recruits and the Darkspear trolls who share Durotar. Troll scouts like Jen'shan prepare hunters and warriors of both races for service to the Horde.

angles.text: As a young orc or troll hunter, you meet Jen'shan first. She teaches you ranged techniques before you leave the red canyons of the Den.
As a troll, you see Jen'shan carry on the Darkspear tradition of tracking and scouting. She teaches young trolls their ancestral hunting ways in their new home on this continent.
